questions.cardText:
[History] Why does Brazil primarily speak Portuguese while the rest of Latin America primarily speaks Spanish?
A. Portuguese settlers arrived in Brazil first
B. Brazil was a Spanish colony that switched to Portuguese later
C. A treaty between Spain and Portugal divided the lands
Answer: C. The Treaty of Tordesillas, signed in 1494, was an agreement between Spain and Portugal to divide the newly discovered lands outside Europe. It granted Spain most of the Americas, while Portugal was given territories in Africa, Asia, and what is now Brazil.
questions.de: Welcher Vertrag zwischen Spanien und Portugal von 1494 teilte die neu entdeckten Länder außerhalb Europas auf und sprach Portugal das heutige Brasilien zu – der Grund, warum man in Brasilien Portugiesisch spricht?
questions.en: Which 1494 treaty between Spain and Portugal divided the newly discovered lands outside Europe, giving Portugal what is now Brazil — the reason Brazil speaks Portuguese?

timeline.labelEn: Spain and Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas, dividing the newly discovered lands outside Europe
timeline.labelDe: Spanien und Portugal unterzeichnen den Vertrag von Tordesillas und teilen die neu entdeckten Länder außerhalb Europas auf

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What is the largest reptile?
A. Alligator
B. Saltwater crocodile
C. Komodo dragon
Answer: B.
questions.de: Was ist das größte lebende Reptil?
questions.en: What is the largest living reptile?

timeline.labelEn: The saltwater crocodile (Crocodylus porosus) is first scientifically described by Johann Gottlob Schneider
timeline.labelDe: Das Leistenkrokodil (Crocodylus porosus) wird von Johann Gottlob Schneider erstmals wissenschaftlich beschrieben

questions.notes: Also called the estuarine crocodile; the card asks 'largest reptile', the source says 'largest living reptile'.
